target:mars-jezero.source: the USGS Mars 2020 CTX stereo terrain model
target:mars-jezero.heightReference: height above the MOLA areoid, as supplied by the product
target:mars-jezero.orientation: North is up and east is right. The source grid is equirectangular with true scale at the equator, so its columns were resampled to make pixels square on the ground at the target latitude.
target:mars-jezero.method: mean of 3 x 3 blocks of the 59.955 m preview grid (the same heights the preview image shades); heights rounded to whole metres

target:moon-south-pole.heightReference: height above the 1737.4 km reference sphere (DN x 0.5 m; the label OFFSET, the sphere radius, is not added)
target:moon-south-pole.orientation: Up is toward 0° E (the Moon's near side, facing Earth) and right is toward 90° E. The south pole is inside the frame, so every direction away from it is north and there is no single north arrow.
target:moon-south-pole.method: mean of 3 x 3 blocks of the 60 m preview grid (the same heights the preview image shades); heights rounded to whole metres
